name: Sanna Governance
description: Constitution enforcement and cryptographic receipts for OpenClaw agent tool execution

constitutionPath.description: Path to YAML constitution file or directory

privateKeyPath.description: Path to Ed25519 private key PEM for receipt signing

publicKeyPath.description: Path to Ed25519 public key PEM for receipt and constitution verification

receiptStorePath.description: Path to SQLite receipt store database

governedTools.description: Tool names to govern. Defaults to all tier 1+2+3 tools.

otelExport.description: Enable OpenTelemetry span export for governance receipts

otelServiceName.description: OpenTelemetry service name for exported spans

llmChecks.description: Enable LLM semantic checks for invariant evaluation

llmChecksModel.description: Model to use for LLM semantic checks

customEvaluatorsPath.description: Path to JS module that registers custom invariant evaluators
